description:
## BCI Pharmacy

**BCI Pharmacy** is a wholesale and retail pharmacy located on **Wilson Road, Kampala**. We are seeking a fastidious, customer-focused **Pharmacy Dispenser** to join our team.

## Position Details

- **Position:** Pharmacy Dispenser
- **Location:** Wilson Road, Kampala
- **Reports To:** Senior Dispensing Pharmacist

## Key Responsibilities

**Prescription & Dispensing**
- Receive, verify, prepare, and label prescribed medications accurately
- Offer basic guidance on medicine usage and storage

**Inventory & Stock Control**
- Apply FEFO (First Expiry, First Out) rules
- Track minimum stock levels and monitor expiry dates
- Assist in receiving/loading shipments and conduct stock reconciliations

**Documentation & Systems**
- Capture all transactions in the pharmacy management system
- Maintain clean audit trails and file prescription records securely

**Quality & Compliance**
- Strictly adhere to Good Pharmacy Practice (GPP), Good Distribution Practice (GDP), National Drug Authority (NDA), and Ministry of Health standards

**Customer Care**
- Attend to retail and wholesale clients promptly and professionally
- Escalate complex clinical enquiries to the Senior Pharmacist

## Required Qualifications & Experience

- **Diploma** or recognized qualification in pharmacy or dispensing
- Professional registration and licensing in compliance with Ugandan regulations
- Prior experience in a pharmacy, hospital, or pharmaceutical distribution environment is an added advantage
- Proficiency in computerized pharmacy software and ERP systems such as QuickBooks or Tally

## Key Competencies

- Solid understanding of pharmaceutical products, storage conditions, and inventory principles
- Exceptional accuracy, attention to detail, and numerical capability
- Excellent interpersonal, communication, and patient confidentiality skills

## How to Apply

📧 **Email:** hr@bcipharm.com

Or submit hard copies directly to **BCI Pharmacy, Wilson Road, Kampala**.

**Deadline**

All applications must be received by **5th September 2026**.
